comment: Debug mode with the wizard-only montelecontrol option: the Priestess creates a sleeping long worm with a tail and two sleeping newts, then zaps a wished wand of teleportation at each newt and forces the first onto the worm head and the second onto a tail segment. place_monster() reports each overlap through impossible(); the second report calls minimal_monnam(worm, TRUE) while level.monsters at the head now holds the first newt, so it names the long worm tail with its coordinates (do_name.c:1271-1275). Independent seed, date and character.
